title: WatchTower settings
description: config/watchtower.settings.json. Optional; documented defaults apply when absent. Unknown keys are rejected (SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_KEY). Also the settings_schema of the Global Workbench WatchTower plugin.

max_future_skew_seconds.description: Producer clocks may run ahead of verification time by at most this much (default 300).

service_bindings.description: Which producer stream reports a Constellation service's health (service_id = registry repository_dir).

policy_pins.description: Expected effective-policy hash per device or effective group; a mismatch is POLICY_DRIFT evidence.

arbiter.description: Optional policy gate (registry integration watchtower > arbiter). Absent: off. Present: every fully verified packet is evaluated by Arbiter and routed on its decision; evaluator failures quarantine (fail closed). The engine is located through WATCHTOWER_ARBITER_ROOT or a sibling arbiter checkout, never through settings.

policyset.description: Root-relative path of the policy.policyset.v1 document.

policy_root.description: Root-relative directory that policyset.rule_files[] are relative to.

timeout_seconds.description: Per evaluation (default 120). A timeout is recorded as outcome unknown and quarantines the packet.
